name: Farmer's Last Stand: Tactical Survival
summary:
Farmer's Last Stand: Tactical Survival
Welcome to Farmer's Last Stand: Tactical Survival, a thrilling wave-based shooter that combines the charm of farming with the adrenaline of survival action. Set in a beautifully designed Wheat Farm Village, players take on the role of a determined farmer dedicated to protecting their cattle and farming animals from an onslaught of zombies and wild creatures.
